messages:
Ben Park: Quick update on billing policy changes were shipping this month. Two small items: 1) a 14-day billing cushion for Startup tier accounts to avoid immediate collections on tiny overages, 2) a phased deprecation of legacy free credits for accounts created before 2023-01-01. Also rolling out a soft per-route cap in the Console for dev environments to reduce surprise spikes. Details below.

Nina S: Is the 14-day cushion the same as a grace period or does it affect invoice amounts?

Ben Park: Good call-out. Cushion = billing collection delay only. It does NOT change invoice math. Customers still see the overage on the invoice, but we wait 14 days before sending automated collection notices for eligible accounts.

Sasha R: Which accounts qualify as Startup tier? Any usage thresholds?

Ben Park: Startup tier = accounts on the Starter plan (monthly charge <$100). Also auto-enrolled if youre within first 12 months of signup and flagged `account.tier=startup`. Overages <= $150 per billing cycle qualify.

Tom L: Do we need changes in the dunning/process? Who gets alerted when cushion ends?

FinanceBot: Finance will receive an automated alert 3 days before cushion expiry for accounts with unresolved balances. Dunning rules unchanged after cushion window.

Nina S: Legacy free credits deprecation  what's the schedule and customer comms plan?

Ben Park: Plan:
 - Phase 1 (now): stop issuing new legacy credits to qualifying accounts; show notice in Console billing banner.
 - Phase 2 (in 60 days): remaining legacy credits will be converted to a one-time promo code with clearly stated expiry.
 - Phase 3 (in 120 days): we remove the legacy credits field from billing screens for new invoices.
Well send a personalised email to affected customers next week with opt-in migration options.

Sasha R: Any regulatory/accounting impacts? Need GL codes?

FinanceBot: Accounting note: converted credits will be logged as promotional liabilities under GL code PROMO-CLR. Weve filed the memo with Audit.

Tom L: The per-route dev cap  how strict? Will it block requests?

Ben Park: Dev cap is safety-only and enforced at the API-gateway for accounts marked `env=dev`. Default cap = 1M tokens/day per route. It returns 429 when hit. Prod accounts unaffected. Flag: `billing.dev_route_cap` to opt-out for specific accounts.

DevOpsBot: Deploy: feature-flag gates in place. Canary to sandbox tomorrow, 10% of Starter accounts in week 1, full roll by day 21. Metrics emitted: billing.cushion_active, billing.legacy_credit_flag, billing.dev_route_hits.

Nina S: How will we reflect the cushion and converted promo in CSV exports?

Ben Park: CSV change: new columns `cushion_status` and `converted_promo_code` will appear for affected invoices. Well ship an example CSV with the release.

Sasha R: Is there any customer-visible calendar for when credits expire?

Ben Park: Yes  emails + Console banner show exact expiry date for each account. We'll also surface a single-click migration button for accounts that want to convert legacy credits earlier.

Tom L: Anything for support teams to triage?

Ben Park: Support playbook: short KB + canned responses. Triage steps: verify account tier, check cushion flag, check promo conversion status, escalate to Finance if > $500 unresolved. KB draft will be in the support channel by EOD.

Nina S: Any risk of customer confusion/angst? We should keep messaging clear.

Ben Park: Agreed. Messaging will emphasize no surprise charges (cushion) and clear deadlines for credits. Marketing will review copy; legal okayed the migration terms.

FinanceBot: Sandbox previews for affected invoices are available at https://console.redwood.ai/billing/previews?batch=legacy-phase (token-limited).

Ben Park: Thanks all. If you want early sandbox access DM me. Will post the external announcement copy after marketing final sign-off. :rocket:
